title: ResponsibilityScope
description: The paths a responsibility may change, declared by the responsibility and enforced by the runner. `never_touch` and workflow paths stay excluded by the runner whatever this allowlist says.

responsibility.description: The responsibility this scope belongs to.

paths.description: Glob allowlist of paths the responsibility may change, relative to each configured directory. No leading `/`, no `..` segment, no backslash, and no brace or extglob syntax (`{`, `}`, `(`, `)`), so expansion cannot produce a `..` segment.

max_diff_lines.description: Largest diff, in changed lines, the responsibility may produce.
